sprint.name: Sprint 3 - Observability & Configurable Strategies
sprint.goal: Deliver MVP with multiple strategy options, policy configuration, observability (logs, CLI dashboard), and deploy automation.

issues.title: Config-driven strategy selection
issues.description: Support multiple strategies (SMA, EMA, buy-and-hold stub) selectable via config.yml.
issues.definition_of_done: Config.yml contains 'strategy: sma/ema/buyhold'; CLI run respects strategy choice.

issues.title: Strategy interface refactor
issues.description: Refactor strategy into pluggable interface class with eval_signals method.
issues.definition_of_done: All strategies implement IStrategy interface; backtest and live run accept any strategy.

issues.title: Configurable policy thresholds
issues.description: Move per-symbol and daily risk limits into config.yml with validation.
issues.definition_of_done: Editing config.yml updates runtime policy enforcement; validation errors printed on load.

issues.title: Config schema & documentation
issues.description: Document config.yml fields and provide example config files.
issues.definition_of_done: README contains annotated config.yml example; config schema defined in code.

issues.title: Health checks
issues.description: Add periodic checks for API connectivity and config load errors; log status.
issues.definition_of_done: Health check runs every N minutes; failures log to structured log with error_code.

issues.title: CLI dashboard for trades & PnL
issues.description: Implement CLI 'report' command: shows trade history, open positions, and cumulative PnL.
issues.definition_of_done: `python -m cli report` outputs readable summary table from SQLite data.

issues.title: Optional lightweight web dashboard
issues.description: If time allows, add FastAPI/Flask web UI to view trades and metrics in browser.
issues.definition_of_done: Start server with `python -m web.dashboard`; browser shows trades table and metrics JSON.

issues.title: Deployment script
issues.description: Write update.sh script to rebuild Docker image, restart container, and run migrations.
issues.definition_of_done: `./scripts/update.sh` rebuilds image, runs migrations, restarts bot container.

issues.title: Version tagging
issues.description: Tag Docker images and releases with version numbers (semver) and push to registry.
issues.definition_of_done: Running CI pipeline produces docker image 'algo-bot:v1.0.0' pushed to registry.

issues.title: Docs update & final runbook
issues.description: Finalize documentation: architecture updates, strategy usage, config setup, deployment runbook.
issues.definition_of_done: Docs folder contains runbook.md and updated architecture.md; README has usage examples.

issues.title: MVP validation run
issues.description: Run 1-week paper trading with multiple strategies; compare live vs. backtest performance.
issues.definition_of_done: Artifacts include metrics, logs, and summary report; consistency validated in review.
